verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Gusto Embedded Payroll's API surface (payroll, contractors, time off, benefits, webhooks, MCP) but contains no mention of offer letters, e-signature workflows, or per-employee HR document storage. Since onboarding/hiring document management is a plausible axis for an HR platform like Gusto, but no supporting evidence exists in this pack, this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
